title: Finite spectral-gap commutator and Duhamel shell bound
question: Can the finite-time bond influence of the moved doubled collision witness be bounded directly by its spectral-gap-weighted commutator, avoiding a separate operator-norm factor?

theorem.setting: A finite Hilbert space, Hermitian bond generator B, unitary U_t=exp(-i t B), faithful density omega and any witness X.
theorem.spectral_identity: In a B eigenbasis, ||U_t^* X U_t-X||_HS^2=sum_{a,b}|exp(i t(lambda_a-lambda_b))-1|^2 |X_ab|^2.
theorem.state_trace_bound: |Tr(omega(U_t^* X U_t-X))| <= ||omega||_HS |t| ||[B,X]||_HS <= |t| ||[B,X]||_HS for a density omega.
theorem.commutant_reduction: The commutator may first be replaced by [B,X-E_B(X)] using the R-364 spectral pinching, including degenerate B eigenspaces.

verification_contract.lean_scope: finite spectral block commutator coefficient identity and nonnegative gap-square fixture

promotion_boundary: R-365 closes only a finite-time unweighted Hilbert--Schmidt Duhamel inequality and its finite state-trace corollary. Uniform local-collar and common-alpha estimates remain open.
next_action: Seek a source- and volume-uniform bound on the spectral-gap commutator norm, preferably in a local modular or Lieb--Robinson space; otherwise register its growth.
boundary: Finite exact spectral algebra plus V=2 Q3 diagnostics. No source/cutoff/volume/prefix/shape-uniform collar, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure follows.
no_overclaim: The Duhamel inequality is finite and unweighted; it does not make the commutator norm uniform or establish a QFT limit.
